YearLuckNarrative: Your Rat sign is NEUTRAL. You tend to be more adept than others when it comes to  getting out of a difficult situation. It is more likely this rather than luck that keeps you in or ahead of the game.
YearSignWealthNarrative: Of all the signs the Rat is in general the best entrepreneur. You are likely to be interested in making money. You could also be endowed with the Rat's vision and foresight, particularly in the area of identifying and acting upon ways to create Wealth. The indicator is LUCKY.
YearHealthNarrative: There are two, Rat characteristics that endanger Health. The first is spending too much time in your head. This can make it difficult for you to relax and adds to stress. The second is a tendency to push yourself to the limit, eventually resulting in  exhaustion. This indicator is therefore UNLUCKY.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the first hour, which is LUCKY, especially in the area of finances.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the first hour, which is associated with career success and wealth, especially if you have your own business and, therefore, LUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between eleven PM and one AM, the first hour, which is NEUTRAL for health. You could suffer energy loss due to a hot temper, but that should be offset by gains from your  successes.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Ox sign is UNLUCKY. Yours is a strong sign, but those born under it usually need that strength, as they end up having to carry the weight of others as well as their own.
YearSignWealthNarrative: It is likely you have the typical Ox qualities of determination and persistence. Although you may not be that ambitious, you are still likely to progress in your work and thus your ability to accumulate Wealth. This, however, doesn't bestow any particular advantage, so this indicator is NEUTRAL.
YearHealthNarrative: In truth the Ox is not the luckiest of signs. Your Health, however, is a bright spot and likely to be robust. Stamina is probably among your greatest strengths. And, if you have that steady, slow but sure, Ox approach, you have a good chance at achieving Longevity. This indicator is LUCKY.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the second hour, which is NEUTRAL, better in your later than earlier years.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the second hour, which is associated with many difficulties in your life and, therefore, UNLUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between one and three AM, the second hour, which is NEUTRAL for health and longevity. It relates more directly to finances and, thus indirectly, tends to be positive.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Tiger sign is LUCKY. The Tiger is revered in China as a guardian and for many, other qualities. It is the Tiger, not the lion, that is king of the animals in China.
YearSignWealthNarrative: As a Tiger you are likely to be competitive and desirous of being in a leadership or managerial position. This puts you in the position to accumulate Wealth. On the other hand you may have a tendency to be obstinate, rash, and rely too much on your own judgment. On balance this indicator is NEUTRAL.
YearHealthNarrative: You are likely to have robust Health and a lot of energy. On the other hand, you are vulnerable to burn out from over exertion. Often Tiger sign people will not slow down, even in the face of danger signs. Your passionate nature only adds fuel to the fire. On balance this indicator is NEUTRAL.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the third hour, which is NEUTRAL, better in the area of finances and in later life and worse in your early years, especially your relationships.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the third hour, which is associated with power and wealth, especially in your later years and, therefore, LUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between three and five AM, the third hour, which is LUCKY. Although your life is not likely to be easy, there is a good chance you will have a prosperous and long retirement.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Rabbit sign is LUCKY. Your sign for the Vietnamese is the cat, and like the cat, you tend to finish upright after a fall. And, as a Rabbit, peace is generally your lot.
YearSignWealthNarrative: Generally the Rabbit is not well suited to the competitive, stressful world of business. You probably have the Rabbit's love of the finer things in life, and that may motivate you to accumulate Wealth, especially if you are able to take advantage of any creative ability you might have. This indicator is UNLUCKY.
YearHealthNarrative: The Rabbit is a symbol of Longevity in Chinese mythology. It is said Rabbits values themselves above all else. This includes you paying attention and attending to your Health needs. Your penchant for avoiding risks is a positive factor in achieving Longevity.  This indicator is LUCKY.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the fourth hour, which is LUCKY, especially in the area of finances.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the fourth hour, which is associated with wealth and a comfortable life and, therefore, LUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between five and seven AM, the fourth hour, which is NEUTRAL. Although you could have a generally fortunate life, various relationship problems could drain your energy.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Dragon sign is LUCKY. Indeed, the Dragon is a symbol of good luck in China, and is honored in New Year's parades, adorns greeting cards and features in decorations of all sorts.
YearSignWealthNarrative: As a Dragon you have the potential to accomplish great things, including amassing considerable Wealth. The question is, are you a mover and shaker destined for success or a show Dragon that looks good in a parade but never really lives up to expectations? On balance this indicator is NEUTRAL.
YearHealthNarrative: It's not unusual for Dragon-sign people to push themselves to the limits in pursuit of their dreams. It may not seem fair, but the lucky Dragon is nevertheless generally blessed with good Health. If you make a reasonable effort to avoid burnout,  so will you. This indicator is LUCKY.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the fifth hour, which is NEUTRAL, better for males than females.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the fifth hour, which is associated with career success and prosperity and, therefore, LUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between seven and nine AM, the fifth hour, which is UNLUCKY. In spite of likely, material success, you may have trouble finding happiness and even experience some loneliness.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Snake sign is NEUTRAL. You will probably be lucky enough to experience great highs in your life. Unfortunately the usual fate of the Snake is to fall to extreme lows just as often.
YearSignWealthNarrative: As a Snake you are more likely than others to have the ambition, depth and charisma to achieve a comfortable financial situation. This can result from career success, marriage, or both. Regardless, you have the potential to accumulate considerable Wealth. This indicator is LUCKY.
YearHealthNarrative: Generally the Snake is blessed with beautiful, if not blemish-free skin. On the other hand, you could be susceptible to stress and burnout in your pursuit to continually raise yourself to new levels or seek extreme experiences.  On balance this indicator is NEUTRAL.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the sixth hour, which is UNLUCKY, especially in the area of relationships.
HourWealthNarrative: You  were born during the sixth hour, which is associated with financial success but also troubled relationships that could have a negative impact and, therefore, NEUTRAL.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between nine and eleven AM, the sixth hour, which is UNLUCKY. You could be susceptible to marriage problems and, or, addictions, either of which would drain your energy.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Horse sign is NEUTRAL. You have your fair share of good and bad in your fate but nothing that is likely to give you a significant advantage or disadvantage over those of other signs.
YearSignWealthNarrative: You probably have flair, stamina and a willingness to work hard to achieve your goals. The question is do you have staying power? The Horse sign's independence, short attention span and restlessness are likely to work against you in this area. This indicator is UNLUCKY.
YearHealthNarrative: As a Horse-sign person you are likely to have robust Health, good vitality and boundless energy. You tend to create your own environment and move on when things don't go your way. This contributes to peace of mind and helps you avoid stress and burnout. This indicator is LUCKY.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the seventh hour, which is NEUTRAL. You are likely to have an interesting and exciting life but not necessarily a fortunate one.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the seventh hour, which is associated with extravagance and moving from job to job and, therefore, UNLUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between eleven AM and one PM, the seventh hour, which is LUCKY. You are likely to have plenty of vitality and exciting travel opportunities that contribute to your positive energy.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Sheep sign is NEUTRAL. You have your fair share of good and bad in your fate but nothing that is likely to give you a significant advantage or disadvantage over those of other signs.
YearSignWealthNarrative: The gentle, yin Sheep does not usually go charging off into the world of business but rather tends to prefer artistic or humanitarian pursuits. You probably like the finer things in life, but you may not be motivated to adopt the behaviors necessary to accumulate Wealth. On balance this indicator is NEUTRAL.
YearHealthNarrative: In China the deer is sometimes used for the eighth sign, and there is a legend concerning the Deer and Longevity. If you're a typical Sheep, tend to live a peaceful life, and keep control of your emotions, you have the potential for a long and relatively healthy life. This indicator is LUCKY.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the eighth hour, which is UNLUCKY, especially in the area of relationships.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the eighth hour, which is associated with relationship difficulties likely to negatively impact finances and, therefore, UNLUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between one and three PM, the eighth hour, which is UNLUCKY for health and longevity. A number of troubled relationships are likely to greatly diminish your energy.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Monkey sign is LUCKY. You are likely to have the Monkey's versatility, making you well-suited to take advantages of the opportunities afforded you in this earthly realm.
YearSignWealthNarrative: The Monkey's fixed element is Metal, the one most closely associated with money. You're also likely to be versatile and capable of earning money in  different ways. Unnecessary risk taking and losing interest, however, could lead to ups and downs in your pursuit of Wealth. On balance this indicator is NEUTRAL.
YearHealthNarrative: When young, Monkey-sign people tend to be overly trusting and usually get hurt. It is possible you could become cynical and suspicious. You also may find it challenging to make yourself happy, often becoming discouraged or depressed instead. This indicator is UNLUCKY.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the ninth hour, which is UNLUCKY, especially in the area of finances.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the ninth hour, which is associated with money that comes and goes easily as well as business failure and, therefore, UNLUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between three and five PM, the ninth hour, which is NEUTRAL for health and longevity. The positive and negative effects in your life are likely to cancel out in terms of ability to affect your energy level.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Rooster sign is UNLUCKY. With your pluck and drive you are capable of being successful, but like the chickens in the barnyard you are likely to have to claw and scratch to achieve your successes.
YearSignWealthNarrative: The Rooster's fixed element is Metal, the one most closely associated with money. Also, Rooster-sign people as a whole tend to be better financial managers than those of other signs. And, in general they are known for an ability to manage people and resources. This indicator is LUCKY.
YearHealthNarrative: As a Rooster-sign person you are likely to enjoy relatively good physical health but could have problems with emotional or mental health. The former is especially true if you exercise regularly. The latter will be true depending on how strongly you exhibit such Rooster traits as perfectionism, being too serious, and frequently assuming an argumentative stance in your interpersonal relations. On balance this indicator is NEUTRAL.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the tenth hour, which is UNLUCKY, especially in the area of relationships.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the tenth hour, which is associated with troubled family relationships negatively impacting your finances and, therefore, UNLUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between five and seven PM, the tenth hour, which is UNLUCKY. Troubled relationships could cause a lot of stress and drain your energy.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Dog sign is NEUTRAL. Yours is among the most well liked signs. And, you have have many positive qualities. In general, however, you probably are not more lucky than your peers.
YearSignWealthNarrative: The Dog's fixed element is Metal, the one most closely associated with money. You're also likely to be valued for your unyielding loyalty, principles and commitment. A tendency to be critical, stubborn and cold, however, could limit your success. On balance this indicator is NEUTRAL.
YearHealthNarrative: As a Dog-sign person you probably tend to maintain an even keel in your daily life. This which would contribute to your resilience, which could be substantial. Your Health overall, nevertheless, is likely to have its ups and downs, especially if you tend to be pessimistic.  Overall this indicator is NEUTRAL.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the eleventh hour, which is LUCKY, especially in the area of finances.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the eleventh hour, which is associated with a hard working attitude, career and financial success and, therefore, LUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between seven and nine PM, the eleventh hour, which is LUCKY. You have a great chance to be successful and not dragged down by the troubles of others, thus  resulting in lots of inner peace.

YearLuckNarrative: Your Pig sign is LUCKY. You will have more than your fair share, which is a good thing, as you will probably need it depending on how much you exhibit the Pig's typical innocence and overly trusting nature.
YearSignWealthNarrative: In the West a wealthy person is sometimes referred to as a fat cat. In China they talk of the fat pig. Indeed, ceramic pigs grace many a Chinese business establishment. Money is likely to come your way, which is fortunate, as you may tend to easily spend and lose it. This indicator is LUCKY.
YearHealthNarrative: The Pig's love of physical pleasures can easily get them into Health difficulties if this becomes excessive, for example, over eating and gaining weight. The negative effect of this is heightened if you are not conscientious about an exercise program.  A positive is you probably have an easy going nature, which helps reduce stress and high blood pressure. Overall this indicator is UNLUCKY.
HourLuckNarrative: You were born during the twelfth hour, which is LUCKY, especially in the area of finances.
HourWealthNarrative: You were born during the twelfth hour, which is associated with success won through hard work and, therefore, LUCKY.
HourHealthNarrative: Your time of birth occurs between eleven PM and one AM. The twelfth hour, which is LUCKY. The combination of a fortunate life and a warm heart bode well for your good health and longevity.
